# jtt whoami

Show the logged-in account, where its token is kept, and the configured projects.

![jtt whoami --check](gifs/whoami.gif)

```console
$ jtt whoami
$ jtt whoami --check
```

It reads the settings only, without calling Jira, unless you pass `--check`, which also asks
Jira whether the token is still valid.

The time zone is your Jira profile's: reports count days as Jira shows them in it. The work
calendar converts between time units (see [`config calendar`](config-calendar.md)).
